title: Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees: Meal-Status Waiver Shares and the Household Annual Fee Cap
content:
For every activity type of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, the share of each waivable fee that a meal-status fee waiver removes, and the most a household is charged in participation fees in one school year after waivers, are the figures below.

| Activity type | Share waived for a student holding any Free Meal Status tier | Share waived for a student holding any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier | Household annual fee cap (participation fees after waivers, per school year) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | 100 percent | 50 percent | 300.00 |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | 100 percent | 50 percent | 300.00 |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | 100 percent | 50 percent | 300.00 |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | 100 percent | 50 percent | 300.00 |
| High School UIL Athletics | 100 percent | 50 percent | 300.00 |
| Cheer and Dance Team | 100 percent | 50 percent | 300.00 |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | 100 percent | 50 percent | 300.00 |

**What the cap counts.** The household annual fee cap is a maximum on participation fees charged to one household per school year after waivers, in US dollars; travel fees, uniform packages, trip fees and late fees do not count toward it.

## Illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

- A hypothetical waivable fee of 47.30 for a student holding a Free Meal Status tier is waived at 100 percent, the whole 47.30.
- The same hypothetical fee for a student holding a Reduced-Price Meal Status tier is waived at 50 percent, 23.65.
- A hypothetical household whose participation fees after waivers already total 287.10 in a school year has 12.90 of room left under the 300.00 cap.
